stages.name: capability introspection
stages.description: Captures SGLang, Python, Torch, CUDA, OpenAI-compatible, native/offline, and structured-output support. Diagnostic only.

stages.name: text-only json structured smoke
stages.description: Runs T0 choice, T1 tiny JSON, and T2 compact VLM schema without image input before image tests.

stages.name: freeform image perception canary
stages.description: Captures private freeform perception traces for generated canary images. It can stop the candidate early, but never completes Phase 39C-SG alone.

stages.name: labels-only structured output
stages.description: Checks expected label/alias recall without boxes or safe-zone reasoning.

stages.name: coarse-region structured output
stages.description: Checks broad zones only: top, bottom, left, right, center, lower_third, upper_third.

stages.name: safe-zone reasoning
stages.description: Checks generated safe-zone recommendations and blocks unknown decisions.

stages.name: composed canonical report
stages.description: Composes the Phase 39C-SG generated-runtime decision from SG3/SG4/SG5 outputs only.

stages.name: optional strict full json report
stages.description: Optional future-facing strict JSON full report after decomposed QA passes. Not required for Phase 39C-SG pass.
